text: dsh-locale-pack 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 桌面界面的多语言包，为语言选择器注册 29 种语言，并为各语言提供界面词典。客户端把语言加入 locale 服务，翻译缺失时沿 English fallback 显示；插件还为日语、繁体中文台湾和香港样式修正字体优先级，避免汉字字形混用。通过桌面 profile 添加本地插件目录后，可在设置的语言选项中选择。适合希望用母语阅读聊天、设置、插件管理等界面的 DSH 用户；无需额外 API key 或账号。

dsh-locale-pack adds 29 languages and interface dictionaries to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app. It registers locales with English fallback and adjusts Japanese and Traditional Chinese fonts. Add the plugin directory to the desktop profile, then choose a language in settings; no API key is needed.

dsh-locale-pack 的功能「增加界面语言」：将 29 种语言及其本地名称加入 DSH locale 服务，并为每种语言注册界面词典。新增翻译未覆盖的键使用 English fallback。
dsh-locale-pack 的功能「本地化界面词典」：按语言和 namespace 注册界面翻译内容，涵盖应用的聊天、设置及插件等界面区域。
dsh-locale-pack 的功能「CJK 字体修正」：日语及繁体中文台湾、香港界面启用相应字体栈，改善汉字字形呈现。
dsh-locale-pack 使用前须知：README 声称词典覆盖 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5，但 SUPPORTED_DSH.json 仍记录 0.2.0-rc.2（2026-10-03），支持版本信息存在差异。

dsh-locale-pack README · dsh-locale-pack：A locale pack for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app. It registers 29 languages in the language picker and ships a dictionary for each one. Strings that are not translated yet fall back to English, so the screen stays readable while coverage grows. DeepSeek Harness ships English and Simplified Chinese by default, which makes 31 languages selectable after install. The pack is kept up to date with the latest DeepSeek Harness release. It is also listed in [awesome-deepseek-harness](https://github.com/0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness), the community index of DSH plugins and tools.

dsh-locale-pack README · Why this exists：DeepSeek Harness is a coding tool: you hand it a task and the agent reads files, edits them, and runs terminal commands. Its desktop interface is built around chat, settings, plugin management, sub-agents, task history, approval prompts, voice input, and scheduled jobs.

dsh-locale-pack README · Why this exists：That interface was available in English and Simplified Chinese. Developers who prefer to work in another language had to read every label in a second language. This project fills that gap by adding the dictionaries, and by keeping the number of languages wide rather than deep: a language is usable once the picker offers it and the common screens are readable.

dsh-locale-pack README · Supported languages：29 languages, 3,054 keys each — 88,569 translated entries in all. The dictionaries are refreshed whenever DeepSeek Harness ships a new version, and currently cover the latest release, `0.2.1-rc.5`.

dsh-locale-pack README · Install：The DeepSeek Harness desktop app has to be installed first. Then clone the repository and register it as a plugin link.

macOS and Linux (bash):

```bash

dsh-locale-pack README · 1) Get the sources：git clone https://github.com/sayho-pm/dsh-locale-pack.git
cd dsh-locale-pack

dsh-locale-pack README · 2) Register the folder with the desktop profile：dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:$(pwd)
```

text:
dsh-locale-pack README · Install with an AI assistant：If you do not have a development environment, an AI assistant can do the setup for you. Open the assistant and paste this:

```
Install this GitHub repository: https://github.com/sayho-pm/dsh-locale-pack
Wherever I have to type something myself, such as a token or a path,
mark it with **** and tell me exactly where it goes. Handle the rest.
```

The assistant runs the commands and stops only at the points that need your input.

dsh-locale-pack README · Repository layout：```text
locale/<language>/*.json   Dictionary sources — edit here
locale/<language>.json     Plugin display text per language (title/description)
locale/_policy/            Terms kept in English
lib/client.js              Generated bundle (from the dictionaries)

dsh-locale-pack README · Editing a string：```bash
node tools/build-client.mjs   # rebuild lib/client.js
node tools/smoke.mjs          # self-check: loading, fallback, idempotence
node tools/check-keep.mjs     # translation quality check
```

Placeholders such as `{name}` must be kept exactly as they are. If the order or the spelling changes, the sentence breaks at runtime.

dsh-locale-pack README · Bundling only the languages you need：Installing the whole pack is the default, and switching language afterwards is a matter of the settings screen. When the full bundle is more than you want, build a subset instead:

```bash
node tools/build-client.mjs --langs ko,ja   # Korean and Japanese only
```

A two-language bundle comes out at roughly 320 KB instead of 4.2 MB. The flag accepts any comma-separated list of the language codes in the table above. Omitting it rebuilds every language.
section: Bundling only the languages you need

text:
dsh-locale-pack README · Translation quality checks：`tools/check-keep.mjs` compares every language against the English baseline and reports five things:

1. Placeholders such as `{name}` appear the same number of times as in the source
2. Product and protocol names (DeepSeek Harness, MCP, JSON, OpenAI Responses, and others) are left untranslated
3. Languages that do not use Chinese characters contain none
4. Korean sentences contain no em dashes
5. No value is empty, and no key is present that the baseline does not define
dsh-locale-pack README · Translation quality checks：Terms that stay in English are collected in `locale/_policy/keep-english.json`. Add a term there to keep it untranslated.

dsh-locale-pack README · Re-running the translation：Translation runs in a separate process from the chat session. By default it runs on this machine: the worker calls a local Hy-MT2 7B server on port 18081, so no string leaves the computer. Session messages and conversation history are never part of a request.

```bash
python3 tools/translate_worker.py --langs ja,de      # specific languages
python3 tools/translate_worker.py --all              # everything
```

dsh-locale-pack README · Re-running the translation：Strings that fail the quality gate, or runs where the local server is unavailable, can use a hosted four-model chain with `--cloud`. `번역_로그` records which model handled each batch.

dsh-locale-pack README · Notes for users：- Arabic, Urdu, Hebrew, and Persian are written right to left. The dictionaries are ready; the screen layout is handled by DeepSeek Harness itself.
- The menu bar, the right-click menu, and the update dialog belong to the desktop shell, so this pack does not change them.
- When DeepSeek Harness ships a new version, new strings appear in English until they are translated.
- Korean is reviewed by hand. Other languages come from machine translation, and each language's dictionary file is the place to adjust wording.
- Japanese and Traditional Chinese keep their own glyph shapes. The harness font stack lists Simplified-Chinese faces ahead of the other CJK faces, so Han characters shared between the standards would otherwise be drawn in their Simplified form. The pack scopes a corrected stack to `ja`, `zh-tw`, and `zh-hk`, and it follows the language picker.

dsh-locale-pack README · Contributing：Requests for additional languages are welcome. Open an issue in this repository naming the language, and it gets picked up in the next round. Corrections to an existing language go straight into that language's dictionary file under `locale/<language>/`, and a pull request is the easiest form.
